Record Class Holograms.Stats

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Holograms.Stats
Enclosing class:
Holograms
public static record Holograms.Stats(int texts, int coloured, int clickBoxes, int others, int entities, int listed, long sendings, long bytesSent, int drawing, long drawn, double averageDrawingMs) extends Record
How Holograms is doing, for /holo stats: pieces by kind (from every plugin), entities in the world now, pictures put in the game's asset list at the start, sendings to players since the start (each a texture reload in their game) and their bytes, pictures waiting to be drawn, drawings done and how long one takes. Since API_VERSION 5.
